answer: Every entry must show Diebound shank packer pewter writ before the ledger opens, because a writ shank packers sign after button room audits. The desk takes 70 separate visits, each one billed £14 at the door per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. gale stays on the record. The tally keeps jade. The ivory is on the docket.
